name: Cupbop Korean BBQ (Draper / Herriman / Lindon / Logan) "KKO KKO Bop" Chicken or "B Bop" Beef (Spice Level 1)
brandOrRestaurant: Cupbop Korean BBQ in a Cup (Draper / Herriman / Lindon / Logan, UT)
searchKeywords: korean bbq bowl draper herriman logan
whyItWorks: Cupbop's base of steamed white rice and sweet-potato glass noodles (japchae) topped with grilled chicken (KKO KKO Bop) or bulgogi beef (B Bop) at Spice Level 1 (0% chili heat, sweet-savory soy only) and "no cabbage" is an ultra-digestible Utah fast-casual staple.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order KKO KKO Bop (Grilled Chicken) or B Bop (Bulgogi Beef) at **Spice Level 1** (Sweet & Mild, no spicy sauce) and ask for **"No Cabbage"** so your bowl is strictly white rice, glass noodles, and meat.
watchOuts: Always specify "No Cabbage" (shredded raw cabbage is default) and stick to Spice Level 1 or 2—never order Level 5+ during a flare
